title: saguin
description: Every metric in the Sagüin catalogue, grouped by area, with Bento pipeline rates alongside.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: saguin_build_info is always 1; labels identify the version and broker id.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: saguin_uptime_seconds is seconds since start.

panels.title: Ready
panels.description: saguin_ready is 1 once listeners and bridges have started, the last snapshot succeeded and the broker is not stopping.

panels.title: Live goroutines
panels.description: saguin_goroutines counts live goroutines by the R1 ownership role.

panels.title: Log lines dropped
panels.description: saguin_log_lines_dropped_total counts lost lines: full when no log credit was available, refused when output failed.

panels.title: Reload results
panels.description: saguin_reloads_total counts SIGUSR1 steps by part (log_and_origins, access, tls) and result (applied, refused).

panels.title: Connected clients
panels.description: saguin_connections counts connected sessions by MQTT protocol; this stat sums both protocols.

panels.title: Served sockets
panels.description: saguin_connections_open counts sockets from service permit to close; max_connections bounds this count.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: saguin_connections counts connected sessions; saguin_connections_accepted_total counts accepted sockets, including refused ones.

panels.title: The fleet mix
panels.description: saguin_connections counts connected clients by protocol, 3.1.1 or 5.

panels.title: Connections refused
panels.description: saguin_connections_refused_total counts CONNECT refusals or closures before CONNACK, by reason.

panels.title: Disconnects
panels.description: saguin_disconnects_total counts the reason selected for each closure, including closures without a sendable DISCONNECT.

panels.title: Subscriptions held by sessions
panels.description: saguin_subscriptions counts durable and non-durable subscriptions at the store refresh boundary.

panels.title: Sessions capped
panels.description: saguin_session_expiry_capped_total counts CONNECTs given max_session_expiry instead of their requested expiry.

panels.title: Subscriptions over time
panels.description: saguin_subscriptions counts subscriptions across every session at the store refresh boundary.

panels.title: Away and restored sessions
panels.description: saguin_sessions_away counts away sessions. saguin_sessions_restored_total counts durable sessions kept across startup after expired sessions ended.

panels.title: Sessions ended
panels.description: saguin_sessions_ended_total counts ended sessions by cause: clean_start, expired or connection_end (expiry 0).

panels.title: Subscriptions held by access rules
panels.description: saguin_subscriptions_held counts subscriptions whose deliveries are held because the ACL no longer allows them.

panels.title: Wills
panels.description: saguin_wills_published_total counts publications by cause (disconnect, lost, takeover, session_end, restart); saguin_wills_waiting counts delayed Wills and saguin_wills_cancelled_total counts reconnect cancellations.

panels.title: Wills dropped
panels.description: saguin_wills_dropped_total counts Wills refused because of channel_full, retained_full or not_authorized.

panels.title: Floor ahead of stored position
panels.description: The maximum offset gap between saguin_channel_floor_offset and saguin_channel_position_min, clamped at zero. Offset gaps are not exact counts of missed records; the minimum is absent where no stored position exists.

panels.title: Retention floor and slowest stored position
panels.description: saguin_channel_floor_offset is the oldest readable offset; saguin_channel_position_min is the lowest stored position, absent where there are none.

panels.title: Stored positions per channel
panels.description: saguin_channel_consumers counts stored positions per channel.

panels.title: Channels
panels.description: saguin_channel_info is always 1; labels identify channel, type and filter. Every channel shares the same SQLite store.

panels.title: Records held
panels.description: saguin_channel_records counts records held in each channel, updated by committed additions and removals.

panels.title: Channel bytes
panels.description: saguin_channel_bytes counts the bytes each channel holds as retention counts them.

panels.title: Records stored
panels.description: saguin_records_stored_total counts records entering a channel; dead-letter moves are excluded.

panels.title: The next offset
panels.description: saguin_channel_next_offset is each channel's tail.

panels.title: Records removed by retention
panels.description: saguin_channel_retention_removed_total counts records retention deleted.

panels.title: Retained values
panels.description: saguin_retained_values counts current retained values on $broadcast.

panels.title: Retained bytes
panels.description: saguin_retained_bytes counts the size of current retained values on $broadcast.

panels.title: Unfinished jobs and worker holds
panels.description: saguin_queue_jobs counts unfinished work by state. The total sums ready, backoff, offered and held; worker holds sum offered and held.

panels.title: Delivered and acknowledged
panels.description: saguin_queue_delivered_total counts attempts handed to workers; saguin_queue_acknowledged_total counts ack responses.

panels.title: Failed attempts and dead letters
panels.description: saguin_queue_attempts_failed_total counts return, timeout and worker_gone. saguin_queue_dead_lettered_total counts jobs moved to dead letters by expired, evicted or attempts_exhausted.

panels.title: Dead letters held and moved
panels.description: saguin_channel_records and saguin_channel_retention_removed_total show dead letters held and removed; saguin_queue_dead_lettered_total counts all jobs moved into dead letters.

panels.title: Unfinished work and acknowledgements
panels.description: saguin_queue_jobs counts unfinished jobs. saguin_queue_acknowledged_total counts ack responses; a rising backlog without acknowledgements needs investigation.

panels.title: Queue workers
panels.description: saguin_queue_workers counts connected workers.

panels.title: Stale queue responses
panels.description: saguin_queue_stale_responses_total counts responses that changed nothing: an invalid payload or an attempt no longer current or owned by that session.

panels.title: Throughput on the wire
panels.description: saguin_bytes_received_total and saguin_bytes_sent_total count all bytes on MQTT connections, including bridges.

panels.title: Publications and deliveries
panels.description: saguin_publishes_received_total counts completely decoded PUBLISH packets, refusals included; saguin_deliveries_total counts PUBLISH packets sent, including resends. Both include bridges.

panels.title: Publishes and subscriptions refused
panels.description: saguin_publish_refused_total counts refused publishes by cause, including QoS 0 drops. saguin_subscriptions_refused_total counts refused filters by reason.

panels.title: Expired broadcast deliveries
panels.description: saguin_deliveries_expired_total counts broadcast deliveries skipped because their Message Expiry ran out; configured channels still deliver expired records.

panels.title: Held incoming QoS 2 messages
panels.description: saguin_qos2_held counts incoming QoS 2 messages of connected sessions waiting for PUBREL.

panels.title: Abandoned QoS 2 messages
panels.description: saguin_qos2_abandoned_total counts held QoS 2 messages discarded because their session ended.

panels.title: Held QoS 2 messages over time
panels.description: saguin_qos2_held counts connected sessions' incoming QoS 2 messages waiting for PUBREL.

panels.title: Abandoned QoS 2 messages over time
panels.description: saguin_qos2_abandoned_total counts held messages discarded when their session ended.

panels.title: Shared QoS 2 messages dropped
panels.description: saguin_shares_dropped_total counts unfinished shared QoS 2 messages dropped when their member's session ended.

panels.title: Publication throttling
panels.description: saguin_publish_throttled_seconds_total counts readers' completed waits for publish allowance to refill.

panels.title: Delivery admission gate
panels.description: saguin_delivery_admission_gated is 1 while the delivery admission gate is closed, independently of whether a publisher is waiting.

panels.title: Delivery admission pause time
panels.description: saguin_delivery_admission_gated_seconds_total counts completed closed intervals by core event times; an ongoing interval is added when it ends.

panels.title: In-flight deliveries
panels.description: saguin_inflight counts QoS 1 and 2 deliveries to connected clients and bridges waiting for acknowledgement.

panels.title: Records missed
panels.description: saguin_missed_total counts exact consumer-record losses since start, by channel and cause (retention or too_large). One record owed to two consumers contributes two.

panels.title: Bridges
panels.description: saguin_bridge_info is always 1; labels identify each bridge and peer.

panels.title: Bridge links
panels.description: saguin_bridge_connected is 1 while the link is up. Subscription readiness is reported separately per rule.

panels.title: Bridge records in
panels.description: saguin_bridge_received_total counts peer records that were stored.

panels.title: Bridge reconnects
panels.description: saguin_bridge_reconnects_total counts links re-established; this view shows the last five minutes.

panels.title: Bridge records out
panels.description: saguin_bridge_sent_total counts records acknowledged by the peer, or sent at QoS 0.

panels.title: Bridge records not sent
panels.description: saguin_bridge_unsent_total counts records not sent, by cause: refused, expired, topic_invalid or too_large.

panels.title: Bridge rule readiness
panels.description: saguin_bridge_rule_up is 1 when an inbound subscription is granted or an outbound rule is sending. A both rule has one series each way and an empty topic label.

panels.title: Bridge connection attempts
panels.description: saguin_bridge_connection_attempts_total counts dials by result, connected or failed.

panels.title: Store mode
panels.description: saguin_store_info is always 1; mode is full, normal or memory. One SQLite store holds every channel and session.

panels.title: Database and WAL bytes
panels.description: saguin_store_bytes is the database size; saguin_store_wal_bytes is its write-ahead log size. Both belong to the shared SQLite store.

panels.title: Records per transaction
panels.description: saguin_store_committed_records_total divided by saguin_store_commits_total is the mean number of records per committed transaction. Transactions include non-publication writes.

panels.title: What closes a transaction
panels.description: saguin_store_commits_total counts committed transactions by fixed cause: event, interval, max_records, barrier or stop. A batch sealed at its byte limit is max_records.

panels.title: Disk full
panels.description: saguin_store_full is 1 from a write refused for disk space until the next saved write.

panels.title: Waiting for store credit
panels.description: saguin_store_no_credit_seconds_total counts completed intervals when the core had no store credit and took no packets.

panels.title: Records committed
panels.description: saguin_store_committed_records_total counts records carried by committed transactions.

panels.title: Snapshot results
panels.description: Memory mode only: saguin_snapshots_total counts snapshots by result, ok or failed. No series in full or normal mode.

panels.title: Last successful snapshot
panels.description: Memory mode only: saguin_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds is the time of the last good snapshot. No series in full or normal mode.

panels.title: Snapshot duration
panels.description: Memory mode only: saguin_snapshot_last_duration_seconds is how long the last successful or failed snapshot took. No series in full or normal mode.

panels.title: Message reservations and budget
panels.description: saguin_memory_in_transit_bytes counts outstanding message reservations. saguin_memory_max_bytes is the configured message budget, not process RSS.

panels.title: Message budget full time
panels.description: saguin_memory_full_seconds_total counts completed intervals when no delivery or reader body reservation could fit; an ongoing interval is added when it ends.

panels.title: HTTP operations requests
panels.description: saguin_operations_requests_total counts HTTP requests by route and response code.

panels.title: MQTT service requests
panels.description: saguin_requests_total counts one terminal result for each seek, kv_get, catalogue or sessions_disconnect request.

panels.title: Garbage collections
panels.description: saguin_go_gc_cycles_total counts completed garbage collections, read from the Go runtime at scrape.

panels.title: CPU spent collecting
panels.description: saguin_go_gc_cpu_seconds_total counts CPU spent collecting; saguin_go_gc_assist_cpu_seconds_total is the part spent by Sagüin goroutines helping.

panels.title: Heap and stacks
panels.description: saguin_go_heap_live_bytes is heap found reachable by the last collection; saguin_go_heap_goal_bytes is the collector goal and saguin_go_stack_bytes is goroutine stack memory.

panels.title: Allocation
panels.description: saguin_go_allocated_bytes_total and saguin_go_allocated_objects_total count heap allocations.

panels.title: GOGC and GOMEMLIMIT
panels.description: saguin_go_gogc_percent is effective GOGC (-1 when off); saguin_go_memory_limit_bytes is effective GOMEMLIMIT.

panels.title: Records a second, end to end
panels.description: The load this dashboard is drawn against, from Bento's own metrics rather than saguin's. Into saguin is the generator's output; out of saguin is the bridge's input; into Kafka is the bridge's output. The three track each other on a stack that is keeping up, and where they separate the gap is a backlog with a side to it.

panels.title: Pipeline failures
panels.description: Publications and productions Bento could not complete: output_error on each pipeline. A saguin refusal reaches the generator here, and a Kafka one reaches the bridge - which is the half of a refusal the broker's own "Publishes refused" panel cannot show, because it counts what saguin answered rather than what the publisher did about it. Flat at zero is the expected reading.
